attestations.note: The day's line gives him the bare epithet of Trebizond; his own page heads him «(1854 - 1920)» and makes him bishop in the region of Amisos, killed by the Turks in 1920 at sixty-six.

birth.note: saint.gr heads his page «Αγιος Νικολαος ο Τραπεζουντιος (1854 - 1920)», and the life ends him «το έτος 1920 μ.Χ. σε ηλικία 66 ετών» — in 1920 at the age of sixty-six, which is the same reckoning.

death.note: saint.gr: «παρέδωσε την αγία του ψυχή στον Θεό το έτος 1920 μ.Χ. σε ηλικία 66 ετών».
